title: Yellowed Saudi Arabian Cheese Flatbread
description: A nostalgic Saudi Arabian dish featuring cardamom and a long fermentation dough, perfect for a snack or light meal. This egg-free friendly flatbread is filled with melted cheese and has a delicious cheese pull.

ingredients.name: Saudi Arabian cheese
ingredients.notes: or similar cheese like akkawi or halloumi

instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine flour, salt, sugar, and yeast.
Gradually add warm water to the dry ingredients and mix until a shaggy dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it ferment in a warm place for 2 hours.
Preheat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat.
Punch down the dough and divide it into 4-6 equal pieces.
Roll out each piece into a thin circle.
Place a quarter cup of Saudi Arabian cheese in the center of each circle.
Sprinkle a pinch of cardamom powder over the cheese.
Fold the dough over the cheese to form a half-moon shape and press the edges to seal.
Cook the flatbread for 2-3 minutes on each side, until it is golden brown and the cheese is melted.
